parent_objective: audit diagnostic-positive sequence target result before source expansion or optimizer design

public_gates: audit whether accepted sequence signal is too narrow
choose next branch: source expansion, repeatability check, or sequence-head shadow probe
keep actor training and PPO blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat the one accepted sequence as sufficient corpus
do not add privileged actor inputs
hypothesis: M613 provides a real but narrow sequence-target signal; the audit should decide whether to expand source diversity or repeat sequence mining before any optimizer step.
success_criteria: audit summarizes accepted and unaccepted sequence evidence
audit explicitly blocks optimizer admission from one accepted sequence
audit selects the next branch without training or PPO
failure_criteria: audit treats one accepted sequence as training-ready

commands.name: audit
commands.command: Analyze M613 sequence target artifacts; no training.

decision_rule: M614 passes if it audits the diagnostic-positive sequence target result and chooses the next no-training branch.
